purpose: Compose a bounded builder stage with optional toolbar, status, and property rail without owning a document model, drag/drop mutation, or serialization.
useWhen: a consumer-owned builder needs a stable stage and inspector composition
canvas content must remain distinct from contextual properties
avoidWhen: a static form or page layout is enough
the library would need to own nodes, persistence, undo history, or collaboration
accessibility: Exposes a labelled builder region and keeps consumer controls in the normal tab order.
Does not require drag, hover, or canvas motion for task-critical actions.
responsive: Keeps stage and inspector in bounded columns on desktop and tablet.
Stacks the inspector below the stage at compact widths without changing content ownership.
motion: Uses shared surface transitions; direct manipulation remains direct.
Does not animate document meaning or selection without consumer direction.
